EpochMs.description: UTC milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

path.description: JSON Pointer into the request body.

Modules.description: Read-only module flags so clients can hide screens and buttons of absent modules.

earnings.description: Earnings module registered (18 section 4.3): the driver can type a total per shift and platform.

receipts.description: Receipts module registered (18 section 5.4); needs expenses.

tax.description: Tax module registered (18 section 7). The estimate itself exists only for countries whose pack is verified or switched on.

local_export.description: Reserved for v1.1; false in v1.

stops.description: Effective flag: the stops module is registered AND settings.stops_enabled is true. When false the phone and the web hide every stop and estimated-split element.

diagnostics.description: Diagnostics module registered (16). When false the phone behaves as level off and the web hides the Diagnostics screens.

capture.description: Capture module registered (16 section 8); false by default.

engine_version.description: The server's track-engine algorithmVersion (14 section 11). A phone with a lower number still shows its own result until sync.

stops_enabled.description: Driver-facing toggle for auto-detected stops, the estimated active/deadhead split and web labelling (decision 1.5b). Default true. Captured per shift at shift start (Shift.segmenter), so changing it never alters an existing shift.

region.description: Subdivision code without the country (CA: ON, QC ...); validated by the country pack.

default_vehicle_id.description: Preselected when a shift starts; always an active vehicle.

diagnostics_level.description: verbose reverts to basic after 7 days (16 section 5).

region.description: A new country clears a region it does not have.

clock_skew_ms.description: Last observed phone-minus-server clock difference; in memory only.

VehicleKind.description: bicycle, ebike, scooter and walking are not automobiles: no mileage allowance rate applies (18 section 4.1).

plate.description: The driver's own record; never exported unless the driver ticks it.

ShiftEarningsPut.description: Omitted amounts are 0 and omitted counts are null, because the row is replaced.

orders.description: The platform's own count for the shift

tax_credit_cents.description: Input tax credit portion (HST/GST/VAT); not more than the amount.

recurrence.description: Makes the row a reminder template, not an expense. Needs next_due.

deductible_cents.description: Computed at read time: amount x business % rounded half up, 0 when not deductible.

double_counts.description: A standard-mileage vehicle's rate already covers this category; saved and warned about

target_cents.description: Gross earnings times the set-aside rate; null without earnings.

supported.description: False when the country has no switched-on pack; then income

unverified.description: True while the pack's figures have not been compared with the primary publications; the screen shows an "unverified rates" notice.

income.description: Effective earnings of the year; null when none were entered or labelled.

expenses_cents.description: null when the expenses module is off.

target.description: Cents, minutes, a count or metres, by metric.

value.description: null when it cannot be known (no earnings entered, no stop-based split), never 0.

estimated.description: True for active distance, the stop-based estimate of 14 section 6.

segmenter.description: The phone sends the value it read from its cached settings (stops_enabled). Omitted (an older phone): the server uses the current setting at receipt.
stops = active_m and deadhead_m are ESTIMATES from detected stops (clients label them so); whole_shift = one active segment. total_m is the same either way.

deduction_cents.description: Computed at read time from the country registry; never stored.

overlaps_shift_id.description: Set when a late upload made this shift overlap another (15 section 9.2).

code.description: One of the flags in 14 section 8.

data.description: The entity in its API shape; null for delete.

Route.description: Parallel arrays of equal length. speed_dmps is null-filled for archived routes.

trip.description: Null only for a trip override whose trip_key matches no trip (reported as override_orphaned).

Stop.description: A derived stop (14 section 6). Never written by a client.

est_role.description: The engine's estimate; none = recorded but does not change the estimate.

stop.description: Null only when DELETE cleared a label whose stop no longer exists (label_orphaned).

rejected.description: Permanently refused points. Everything not listed here is stored.

upload_hint_s.description: Suggested seconds until the next upload (15 while a web client is watching

WsServerMessage.description: Any frame sent by the server. The client replies to ping with {"type":"pong"}.

earnings_cents.description: Effective earnings (18 section 4.3) - the driver's typed totals

deduction_cents.description: null when the selected country has no registered pack.

hourly_earnings_cents.description: earnings_cents divided by hours; null when hours is 0.

platform_filter.description: Present only when the platform query was given.

diagnostics.description: Present when the diagnostics module is on (16 section 7.2).

verbose_until.description: Epoch ms; verbose reverts to basic then.

capture.description: For a device, its own active capture session; always null for a web session.

seq.description: Required for phone sources; strictly increasing per (device

data.description: Typed fields defined per kind in the shared package registry (16 section 3.2). Unknown fields are rejected. Never a coordinate, address, payout, label or free text (16 section 4).

discarded.description: Verbose events accepted but not stored because disk is low.

id.description: H1 to H7 (device checks) or S1 to S5 (server checks), 16 section 10.1.

weight.description: Points toward the 0 to 100 score; absent for server checks.

shift.description: Shift client_id the fixes belong to.

text.description: Free text; capture data is not diagnostics and may contain it (16 section 8.2).
